headline: First Light | Dabur India

highlights: Results Highlights: Dabur’s consolidated revenue grew 11.6% YoY to Rs 45bn, driven by broad-based growth across domestic and international businesses.
India FMCG revenue grew 10.7%, supported by volume growth of 5.5% and pricing growth of 5.2%, while the international business registered strong growth of 20%.
Operating profit rose 7.5% YoY to Rs 6.3bn, with operating margin contracting 60bps, primarily due to higher input costs and supply chain and freight expenses in international markets.
Despite margin pressure, PAT grew 11.7% YoY to Rs 5bn, marking the fourth consecutive quarter of double-digit PAT growth.
valuation: The company plans to increase consumer-facing media investments by 150– 200bps and targets premium portfolio contribution of 23% by FY28 (20% currently).
It targets 1.5x the savings achieved in the first 18 months of Vision VII, following Rs 1.15bn of savings, to fund higher brand investments.
Management reiterated its guidance of double-digit revenue growth for FY27, while remaining selective on M&A amid elevated valuations.
watch: Management is also focusing on OTC and digestives, premium beverages and foods as key growth drivers, alongside continued portfolio rationalisation.
While our FY27-28 estimates are largely unchanged, we cut FY29E EBITDA/EPS by ~11%/~10%, reflecting a softer margin outlook.
